name: Amazon Data Firehose
sku: Amazon Data Firehose, formerly Kinesis Data Firehose. Optional transformation of records before delivery is not scored.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: A fully managed service for delivering real-time streaming data to S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, Splunk, Apache Iceberg tables and HTTP endpoints, buffering records by size or time. Producers send data in, or Firehose reads a Kinesis data stream. It delivers and does not process the stream.

presentation.tagline: Delivers streaming data to S3, Redshift, Iceberg tables and other destinations.
